Description:
[b][size=4]***This is not a copy/paste replacement but a mod and will need to go in the StardewValley/Mods folder.
You will need Content Patcher by Pathoschild for it to run. Download it [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]here[/url]***
[/size][/b]

[size=3][b]1.3 Update[/b]: Fixed the coding problem with Content Patcher. [/size]
[size=3][b]1.2 Update[/b]: Changed the XNB replacer into a Content Patch. Now only one file for both Hairy and Smooth options.[/size]

[size=3]This mod will replace both Clint's portrait and his in game sprite to a shirtless, muscular (and optionally hairy) hunk.
[/size]

[size=6]How to install:[/size]

[size=3] ﻿ ﻿1. Install Content Patcher using this link [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]here[/url][size=3]﻿.[/size]
[size=3] ﻿ ﻿2. Download the file.[/size]
[size=3] ﻿ ﻿3. Extract the zip file and paste the contents into your Mods folder.[/size]
[size=3] ﻿ ﻿4. Run the game once so a config.json file is created in the folder for Sexy Hairy Clint.[/size]
[size=3] ﻿ ﻿5. Select if you want to keep him hairy (default) or smooth by changing "true" to "false".[/size]


[size=3]Portrait based on [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/63/?]Hot GingerBeard Clint[/url][size=3] by undare.[/size]
